raw_text: Maintain an authentic, honest BCA student ML portfolio (React + Vite + Tailwind); avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. Never claim professional experience not actually achieved or research credentials not earned. Avoid flashy marketing, exaggerated personal branding, heavy animations, or distracting motion. Use modern developer portfolio/AI dashboard styling; accents #38BDF8/#22D3EE, headings Space Grotesk. Use reusable, modular React components and clean structure; avoid unnecessary dependencies/complexity. Mobile-first: responsive grids, readable text, large touch buttons, lazy-load images. Titanic project: Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Logistic Regression; Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn. Use icons for navigation, skills, project cards; fade-in section reveals. “Try the Model” form is optional; skip if complex. Ensure clean modern UI, clear ML projects, authentic content, working mobile layout, fast performance.
